name: Transforms Creature
description: Wholesale replaces a creature's own game statistics with a different creature's, for the duration.

mechanics.text: While active, the target's game statistics are replaced by those of a different creature (chosen at activation, subject to whatever restriction the source material states — a challenge rating cap, a creature type ban, etc.), retaining only what its own source text says survives the change. Distinct from feat.summoned-companion (a new creature appears, rather than an existing one changing shape) and feat.illusory-disguise (only the target's appearance changes, not its actual statistics).
